channels.name: Serial lanes (L differential pairs)
channels.active_levels: differential CML NRZ, AC-coupled; up to 12.5 Gbps (204B) / 32 Gbps (204C)

channels.name: Device Clock (DEVCLK)
channels.purpose: Common master clock; source of frame clock and LMFC.

channels.name: SYSREF
channels.active_levels: single / periodic / gapped-periodic pulse, sampled by DEVCLK

channels.name: Command channel (204C, optional)
channels.purpose: In-band control/status in the 64b/66b link layer.

global_signals.name: Device Clock
global_signals.purpose: Common clock for the whole link.

global_signals.name: SYSREF
global_signals.purpose: Subclass 1 LMFC alignment for the whole link.

handshake_pairs.name: SYNC~ request
handshake_pairs.rule: RX asserts SYNC~ to request CGS; TX responds with /K28.5/ commas; RX de-asserts to start ILAS.

handshake_pairs.name: ILAS config exchange
handshake_pairs.rule: TX sends the link-config octets in ILAS MF2; RX verifies via FCHK.

handshake_pairs.name: SYSREF alignment
handshake_pairs.rule: SYSREF aligns the LMFC at TX and RX (Subclass 1).

handshake_pairs.name: Multiframe alignment
handshake_pairs.rule: /A/ at multiframe and /F/ at frame boundaries maintain alignment (204B).

handshake_pairs.name: Error resync
handshake_pairs.rule: RX re-asserts SYNC~ on link error to restart CGS (204B).

dependency_graph.common_rule: All lanes share the Device Clock; the frame clock and Local MultiFrame Clock (period F*K frames) are derived from it. The LMFC is aligned to SYSREF (Subclass 1) or SYNC~ (Subclass 2). Lanes are aligned to a common multiframe boundary during ILAS and maintained by /A//F/ characters (204B). The link must complete CGS and ILAS before the data phase.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Data transmission requires: (1) CGS achieved (character alignment on /K28.5/ on all lanes), (2) ILAS completed and FCHK verified, (3) the LMFC aligned for deterministic latency in Subclass 1/2. The receiver elastic buffer releases aligned data at the LMFC boundary.

fields.ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

logical_signaling_levels.name: CGS commas
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Continuous /K28.5/ on the lanes while SYNC~ is asserted.

logical_signaling_levels.name: ILAS
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Four multiframes aligning lanes and carrying the link config.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Data
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Framed (optionally scrambled) converter samples with /A//F/ alignment characters.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Line-coded NRZ per lane (8b/10b 204B / 64b/66b 204C); embedded clock recovered by CDR.
ordering_rules.sample_order: Samples ordered by converter / sample position within the frame, striped across L lanes.
ordering_rules.multiframe_order: Frames grouped into K-frame multiframes; the multiframe is the lane-alignment unit.
ordering_rules.direction: Unidirectional payload (converter->logic ADC / logic->converter DAC); SYNC~ is the reverse low-speed control.
